intro.text: A lighteyed Alethi woman from Highprince Aladar's warcamp and an acquaintance of Adolin Kholin.

items.text: At a gathering of young lighteyes in a wineshop in the Outer Market, Eshava complained about Dalinar Kholin's strict adherence to the Codes and suggested he should abdicate, angering Adolin. She tried to change the subject, but Toral told Adolin that many people agreed with her.
